title: The Difference Engineers and New Madrid
summary: An early Adept experiment that shook the Mississippi valley.

claims.text: The first Difference Engineers held that reality was a perception they could rework with Correspondence, Pattern and Entropy.
Adepts say an attempt to make a lake and reroute the Mississippi set off the New Madrid quakes and opened the fault that still exists; Technocrats call it a natural anomaly.
Babbage's engine led the dissenters to think computation could unify the other Spheres.

title: The death of Alan Turing
summary: The killing that drove the Adepts from the Union.

claims.text: Adept lore holds that a Man in Black shot Turing and staged it to look like suicide.
With their leader gone, the Technocracy expected the Adepts to obey, and each side badly misjudged the other.
Later research turned up the Turing Virus, a mental block that wiped any memory of a Turing project whenever the name was spoken aloud.

title: The Adepts after the Avatar Storm
summary: How the Tradition changed in the new century.

claims.text: Before the Avatar Storm the Adepts were the flashy newcomers whom other Traditions did not take seriously.
After a century of insisting information should be free, the Adepts finally pried loose the truth about their own past and purpose.
Adept teaching runs on tests: hacker attacks, Correspondence rotes and Mind games, called Flame Wars, are meant to find the right teacher.
Losing the Digital Web and facing police pressure on hackers and anarchists made Cyberpunks rediscover the ideals behind punk and anarchism.
Instead of blind raids, they now attack the myths that prop up Technocratic control, opening Sleeper eyes and upsetting the Union's Timeline.
They still believe a new world must rise from the ashes of the old, though most see that as a fool's dream.

title: Cypherpunks
summary: The Cryptogramics who hide the Adepts' data.

claims.text: Cypherpunks arose after the Cyberpunks crashed the It-X mainframe and the Technocracy struck back in real and virtual space.
Leading mathematicians encrypted and hid Adept streams so that for each Technocratic success, three or more Adept sites vanished.
Believing it had won, the Technocracy eased off; the hidden Adepts were safe behind layers of deception.

title: Chaoticians
summary: Grey Men and Arithmeticians, the Adepts' mathematicians.

claims.text: Chaoticians claim descent from ancient mathematicians and say their insight into universal mathematics sparked the debate that founded the Order of Reason.
When the Order of Reason formed in 1325, mathematicians made a sub-lodge, the Arithmeticians, never strong enough to be a Convention.
In the 1800s they joined others around the computer to become the Difference Engineers, finally finding a place in the Union.
